body: Embedded dashboard verification complete under Bun 1.4.0. Canonical package pipeline ( un run build) built the Vite frontend then compiled with --asset src/dashboard/client/dist; artifact is 90563584 bytes, SHA-256 357D308C92483C176EA4FD96AA59C50E1A318D448B99EE9031DAB29F9D81C3F0. Full suite: 245/245 tests, typecheck, Biome, source project/views validation, and compiled validation passed. New copied-binary smoke launches from a temp unrelated project with no source/dist directory and verifies CLI version/validate, MCP stdio validate_ledger, root + hashed SPA asset, SPA fallback, API, graph JSON, MIME types, missing assets, and encoded traversal rejection. Source static-route tests also cover favicon when present. Production assets resolve via Bun's embedded import.meta.dir/dist, never the target ledger root; Vite dev source directory is module-relative and uses the currently running Bun executable.
